jump_ci.verdict: real-looking (lifecycle commitment/upgrade threshold strongly coupled with months 10-12; retains Lane 2 as controlled A/B pilot)

hypotheses.title: Pre-300-Day Handset & First-Year Commitment Expiry
hypotheses.statement: Customers whose current handset approaches or passes 300 days (301-340d churn = 60.69% vs 260-300d = 36.85%, +23.83 pp) and who enter months 10-12 of service (57.83% churn, peaking at 64.57% in month 11) are substantially more likely to churn because their initial 12-month promotional commitment or handset replacement cycle expires; we test this with lifecycle features (dev_age_gt_300, tenure_10_12, eqp_per_tenure), partial dependence, and a controlled A/B pilot (Lane 2).

hypotheses.title: Active Usage Drop Before Silent-SIM Abandonment
hypotheses.statement: Customers whose monthly voice minutes drop sharply relative to their 3- and 6-month baseline (change_mou < 0, missing change_mou at 76.03% churn, or 10 < mou_Mean <= 65 at 54.74% churn) are more likely to churn because they are shifting primary call volume to a competing SIM before going silent (whereas mou_Mean == 0 at 78.48% churn contributes only 0.62% of revenue and is already gone); we test this with usage-trend ratios and missingness flags.

hypotheses.title: Bill Shock (Overage Share) & Uncapped Spend Exposure
hypotheses.statement: Customers whose overage charges exceed 40% of their monthly bill (churn = 54.20% vs 47.44% at 0%-20%), who lack an Account Spending Limit (asl_flag=N churn = 50.90% vs 41.37% for Y), or who face top-quartile call drop/block rates (>8.85%, churn = 51.71% vs 46.75% in Q1) are more likely to churn due to bill shock and network friction; we test this with recurring_share, overage_share, roam_share, and drop_blk_rate features.

pilot_design.primary_kpi: Incremental 60-day retention rate (r_treatment - r_control) and Net Retained Margin (MU)

impact.executive_statement: Estimated under stated PoC assumptions (N=100,000, ARPU=58.72 MU, margin=70%, H=6m, V=246.62 MU, save rate s=20%, cost c=8.00 MU): at k=10%, Base net ranges from -39,153 MU (pi_r=2%) to +13,160 MU (pi_r=5%) and +82,557 MU (pi_r=10%; +90,940 MU at k*=15%). The break-even churn prior at k=10% is 4.19%; at pi_r=2%, restricting outreach to Top 1–2% stays positive (k*=1%: +3,590 MU).

problem_definition.selected_framing: Two-Lane Retention Program (Lane 1: Monthly ML Risk-Ranked + Value-at-Risk Targeting; Lane 2: Controlled 90-Day A/B Holdout Pilot at Months 8-9 & eqpdays 240-290)
problem_definition.ml_task_type: Supervised binary classification and calibrated probability ranking (target: churn in {0, 1} during days 31-60)
problem_definition.exclusion_rule: Exclude silent SIMs (mou_Mean == 0, n=1,600 all / 1,120 train, 22.89 MU/mo, 0.62% of total revenue) from paid incentives
problem_definition.primary_online_kpi: Incremental Retention Rate (r_treatment - r_holdout) and Net Retained Margin (MU) in 90-day randomized holdout pilot
problem_definition.primary_offline_kpi: ROC-AUC, Precision@10%, Lift@10% (raw pi_s=49.562% and re-based pi_r in {5%, 10%}), and Brier calibration score
problem_definition.decision_owner: Head of Customer Value Management (CVM) & Retention (supported by CRM Operations, Device/Commercial Product, and Network/Care Triage)

levers.driver: mou_ratio_3m & change_mou (Voice Usage Drop vs 3m Avg)
levers.evidence: Perm AUC drop = -29.85e-3 (#1); silent 0 MOU lines churn at 78.5%, missing trend at 76.0%
levers.implied_action: Trigger proactive voice/data bonus or multi-SIM loyalty bundle when active subscriber MOU drops >25% vs 3m avg (while excluding mou_Mean == 0 silent SIMs)

levers.evidence: Perm AUC drop = -21.09e-3 (#2); churn jumps from 29.3% (m=9) to 64.6% (m=11)
levers.implied_action: Contact subscribers in months 8–9 (before the month 10–12 cliff) with a commitment renewal / loyalty perk in a 50/50 holdout A/B pilot

levers.evidence: Perm AUC drop = -15.68e-3 (#3) + -3.07e-3; +23.83 pp jump past 300d across 19/19 areas
levers.implied_action: Send targeted trade-in / installment upgrade voucher at eqpdays 240–290 to high-value active accounts in a 50/50 holdout A/B pilot

levers.driver: totmrc_Mean, rev_ratio_3m & recurring_share (Tariff Fit & Overage Shock)
levers.evidence: Combined Perm AUC drop = -19.03e-3; overage >40% of bill raises churn to 54.2% (ASL lowers by -9.5 pp)
levers.implied_action: Migrate high-overage accounts to predictable higher-tier recurring bundles and enable Account Spending Limit (ASL) protection

levers.evidence: Perm AUC drop = -6.49e-3 & -5.86e-3; budget handsets (<100 MU) churn higher than premium tiers
levers.implied_action: Scale retention offer cost (c) to customer recurring margin (V) so costly subsidies go only to high-margin accounts
